definition.pytest: tests/test.sh writes /logs/verifier/reward.txt 1 iff its single pytest invocation of tests/test_outputs.py exits 0 (/tests/test_outputs.py, or test_outputs.py after cd /tests). No other status is conjoined. An `exit 1` when PWD=/ that writes no reward is a precondition, not a second grader.
definition.both: reward.txt is 1 only when pytest on tests/test_outputs.py exits 0 AND another command's exit status is also 0.
definition.shell: The reward is decided by tests/test.sh or tests/verify.sh without pytest on tests/test_outputs.py.
definition.neither: Neither pytest tests/test_outputs.py nor tests/test.sh nor tests/verify.sh decides the reward.

verifier_in_task_toml: All 89 [verifier] sections set only timeout_sec. None names a script, a pytest path, or reward.txt.

environment_shadows.note: Frozen primary_grader prefers a path ending in tests/test_outputs.py that does not contain environment/. Every task has tests/test_outputs.py, so the claims-file fallback (environment/tests/test_outputs.py only when the task has no tests/ grader) matches 0 tasks. The five environment copies are byte-identical to the tests/ copies and are not the pytest target.

unspeakable_for_frozen_classifier.why: Rules apply to the primary grader tests/test_outputs.py bytes, or environment/tests/test_outputs.py only when the task has no tests/ grader. primary_grader is fix-code-vulnerability/tests/test_outputs.py. tests/test.sh writes reward 1 only if a path-less `python -m pytest` (commented 'test from original repo'; ctrf path original-repo-ctrf.json) exits 0 AND `python -m pytest /tests/test_outputs.py` exits 0. The path-less conjunct is not the primary file. The task's tests/ tree is only test.sh and test_outputs.py. environment/Dockerfile sets WORKDIR /app and clones https://github.com/bottlepy/bottle.git at 0207a34f0c5716cd292dd4480253ad35d3da49f3 into /app; that checkout is not in the frozen population. The marker rules have no second-suite conjunct, so they cannot speak to the whole score.

spoken_shapes_checked: configure-git-webserver: tests/verify.sh does not write reward.txt and tests/test.sh does not reference it. tests/test_outputs.py line 11 runs `subprocess.run(["bash", "/tests/verify.sh"])` and line 13 asserts 'TEST PASSED' in stdout. Reward follows that pytest. The behaviour marker matches subprocess, so the rules speak to the primary file. They do not parse verify.sh.
git-multibranch: no verify.sh blob. tests/test_outputs.py writes a verify.sh string and runs `os.popen("bash verify.sh")`. os.popen matches the behaviour marker.
fix-ocaml-gc: `make -C testsuite one DIR=tests/basic | tee tests.txt` runs before pytest. reward.txt uses the pytest `$?` only.
cancel-async-tasks: test.sh copies tests/test.py to /app/test.py. test_outputs.py executes python test.py. Reward follows pytest.
large-scale-text-editing: test.sh runs python3 /tests/gen_large_csv.py before pytest. Reward follows pytest.
87 of 89 test.sh exit 1 when PWD=/ and do not write reward.txt (absent on hf-model-inference and kv-store-grpc). Precondition, not the graded assertions.
